items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: And Benny -- I think Beeny Waters we were talking about at the time.

ctx.x:
Ol' man Selmer had gave him a horn,
a gold horn. I say, "Man, maybe I'll try one of them,"
you know.

And Benny -- I think Beeny Waters we were
talking about at the time. So I decided when we
went to the Paramount, I was going to get me a
Selmer.

Went down to Manny's and the Selmers
had came in. And Manny said, "Give me that Conn horn,
I'll trade you."
